notes: οὐ μή is kept whole as one noncompositional unit under rule 33 and οὐδέν takes *nothing* separately; the two negatives are not adjacent, so rule 41's emptying is not in question.
The head of *in any wise* falls on *wise*, the phrase's nominal word, since rule 33's *no* is absent; heading on *any* as the polarity item answering to the pair remains defensible.
